name: scout-skills
description: Copilot m-skills exposed as MCP tools: inverse-debate-theory, intentional-words, cowork-auth-config, cowork-chat, cowork-cli-install, 3dkg, persistent-powershell.

tools.name: inverse_debate_theory
tools.description: Run a problem through inverse-debate-theory: four independent parallel agent sessions (GPT-5.5 agree, GPT-5.5 disagree, Opus 4.8 agree, Opus 4.8 disagree), four collaborative rounds, and Near/Far/Long synthesis.

problem.description: The problem, decision, claim, strategy, design, or assumption to debate.

tools.name: intentional_words
tools.description: Calculate and refine wording by launching multiple independent runtime agents in parallel, each challenging the words from a unique perspective, then collaborating through subloops and Near/Far/Long horizon synthesis.

text.description: The wording, message, or text to refine and stress-test.

context.description: Optional background context about the audience, relationship, or stakes.

goal.description: What the text needs to accomplish (inform, persuade, reassure, escalate, etc.).

tools.name: cowork_auth_config
tools.description: Manage Cowork CLI authentication and configuration: cowork auth login/check/status/whoami/refresh/logout and cowork config init/show/set.

command.description: The cowork auth or config sub-command to run.

tools.name: cowork_chat
tools.description: Launch and manage the interactive cowork chat REPL in a persistent PowerShell session for streaming multi-turn chat.

message.description: Initial message to send to the cowork chat REPL.

tools.name: cowork_cli_install
tools.description: Install cowork-cli natively on Windows via the aka.ms PowerShell installer and wire it into a reusable persistent PowerShell session.

force.description: Force reinstall even if cowork is already on PATH.

verify_only.description: Only check if cowork-cli is installed and return its version.

tools.name: query_3dkg
tools.description: Query and work with the 3DKG knowledge graph, txt2kg APIs, DarbotDB (ArangoDB), and QMD MCP memory surface on 10.1.8.69.

query.description: Natural language or AQL/SPARQL query against the knowledge graph.

raw.description: Return raw API response rather than summarised result.

tools.name: persistent_powershell
tools.description: Create and manage long-lived PowerShell work sessions for parallel command execution, coding agents, service probes, and reusable terminal workflows.

shell_id.description: Identifier for the persistent shell session.

command.description: PowerShell command to execute (for run action).

detach.description: Run detached so the process survives session shutdown.
